Hosting

Website hosting, looked after for you

Webco Cloud hosts the website so it stays available. The technical work sits behind a simple service: the site, the domain, email and support in one relationship.

What hosting covers

  • The live website

    The site Webco Media built is published and kept online.

  • SSL

    The site is served over HTTPS.

  • The first year

    When Webco Media builds the website, the first year of hosting is part of that work, along with domain setup where a domain is included.

After the first year
